issuing_body: Minnesota Legislature / Office of the Revisor of Statutes
author: State of Minnesota
title: 2026 Minnesota Laws, Chapter 127
notes: Official Revisor session-law text. Added to replace reliance on a future recodified-statutes display for the 2026 Medical Assistance fraud provisions.
supports: The enacted 2026 session law supplies the controlling article text for Minnesota's new Medical Assistance fraud offense framework while the permanent-statutes display is being recodified.
The act contains the new offense structure, including provider-enrollment and records-related conduct and value-based offense tiers, and repeals prior section 609.466 as specified by the act.
Until the 2026 Minnesota Statutes compilation is final, Chapter 127 is the appropriate primary pin-cite source for these enacted changes.
does_not_support: That every provision is effective before the effective dates stated in the act.
A permanent 2026 Minnesota Statutes section number where the Revisor has not yet completed recodification.
